intent.oneSentence: A living fire phoenix flies toward the viewer, spreads its burning wings, draws their energy into its chest and releases a suspended solar explosion.
intent.firstRead: A luminous flying phoenix made of articulated fire feathers and moving embers.
intent.mustNotReadAs: A static bird logo, fan of straight rods, noodle ribbons, flat polygon sticker or unrelated fireball.
intent.useContext: A native 480×360 pixel effect on a dark cinematic background, exported at integer 2× scale.

readability.primaryShape: Unequal evolving fire-feather fronts form two broad wings around a crowned bird head, narrow chest and flowing tail; no permanently repeated fixed-size feather gradient.
readability.focalPoint: The head and chest remain distinct from the wings until a brief chest-centered release.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Red rear feather planes are below golden primary feathers. Particle trails originate on past wing poses. Foreground embers cross the silhouette selectively.
readability.contrast: White is reserved for localized thermal ridges and the release. Fire contours use discrete orange and gold ramps, with soft light confined to the light buffer.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: Several hundred live wing embers but few large accents. Trails must reinforce flight rather than drown the avian silhouette.

mechanics.source: A central chest core feeds both wings; feather tips release material along their movement.
mechanics.driver: Articulated wing strokes and a rising forward flight path. Charge retracts wing energy into the central source.
mechanics.direction: Wing flow travels outward and then sheds rearward/upward; the final chest release expands outward.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Low-mass luminous plasma and sparks, with brighter tightly clustered material at the moving feather roots and dimmer cooling wakes.
mechanics.causalChain: The chest feeds short-lived wing fronts that grow, change width, carry hot material outward, fork and lose their roots while replacement fronts ignite. The established wing sparks and final chest release remain unchanged.
mechanics.endingRule: The main body is consumed by the release. Outward material continues moving as it cools; the effect ends fully empty at 5.6 seconds.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: Original stylized 2D POKU effect with projected depth cues and analytically authored fire lifecycles. Not Unreal/Niagara output or fluid simulation. Changing geometry is observable but automated tests do not certify convincing fire or user approval.

phases.name: preparation
phases.action: The chest ignites and the wings unfurl.
phases.visibleCue: A small gold source broadens into a complete bird silhouette.

phases.name: action
phases.action: The phoenix flies with two deliberate wing strokes, then draws energy inward.
phases.cause: Wing articulation and increasing central charge.
phases.visibleCue: Wings change lift and camber, tails lag, wing sparks detach from their birth positions, chest intensifies near release.

phases.name: response
phases.action: The chest source releases an expanding fire shell and many outward streaks.
phases.cause: The charged core releases its stored energy.
phases.visibleCue: Brief white-gold flash, broken curved fire front and accelerating outward fragments.

phases.name: ending
phases.action: Fire fragments become sparse orange embers and vanish.
phases.cause: No further energy or particles are emitted.
phases.visibleCue: Particles continue moving outward while cooling and fading, leaving the background empty.

references.source: firebird_refs/pinterest_phoenix.jpg and firebird_refs/layau.jpg, visually inspected local references
references.observed: Legible flame feathers, narrow avian body and differentiated flowing tail, with explicit hot inner structures.
references.application: Original frontal silhouette and fire material hierarchy, with wholly new articulated geometry and choreography.
references.limits: No pixels, old phoenix source or animation assets are copied. References do not certify the new effect.
